title: Resolution to schedule hearing on raising 8 BID budgets
summary: This resolution sets the date, time and place for a public hearing on proposed increases to the annual spending caps of eight business improvement districts: 34th Street, 82nd Street, East Mid-Manhattan, Myrtle Avenue Brooklyn, Bay Ridge 5th Avenue, Southern Boulevard, Greater JFK and West Village. The proposed new annual expenditure limits, effective July 1, 2027, range from $354,450 for 82nd Street to $16.3 million for 34th Street. The hearing is required before the Council can pass a local law authorizing these increases.
